scenes.title: Thirty-Five Minutes
scenes.summary: Etienne panics over the double-booked room while Henri unlocks the third-floor staircase.

scenes.title: The Sunny Attic
scenes.summary: Up in the quiet attic room, Claire, Henri, and Nadia inspect the space and list what is missing.

scenes.title: Left at the Landing
scenes.summary: Claire, Nadia, and Etienne finish making the bed, plug in the warm lamp, and hear the front gate bell.

scenes.title: In from the Rain
scenes.summary: Quiet architect Antoine arrives soaked from the rain, and Claire and Nadia warm him up before explaining the room change.

scenes.title: Half Price and Quiet Beams
scenes.summary: Shown the cozy attic room at half price, Antoine admires the timber ceiling and happily takes the key.

scenes.title: A Five-Star Sigh of Relief
scenes.summary: Downstairs Etienne celebrates the solved double-booking until Claire spots a small leather notebook left on the counter.

scenes.title: Returning the Notebook
scenes.summary: Claire returns Antoine's leather notebook and hears the radiator pipe clank and go lukewarm.

scenes.title: Ice-Cold Pipes
scenes.summary: Coming up from the cellar, Henri delivers bad news: the hot-water boiler valve just cracked for the night.
